name: Post SSC Scholarship for Boys/Girls from Socially and Educationally Backward Classes
benefit: - Yearly scholarship of ₹1,500/- to ₹5,000/- depending on the academic group (Group A to D).
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a student who has passed the SSC examination. 1. The applicant should belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) or a Notified Tribe or De-Notified Tribe (NTDNT) community of Gujarat. 1. The annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/- for boys. **Note:** There is no income limit for girl students.
